final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as A FROM telescopes WHERE powerstatus IS NOT NULL GROUP BY powerstatus), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(A) as B FROM step1) SELECT step1.powerstatus, step1.A, CAST(step1.A AS FLOAT) / step2.B as division_result FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.B IS NOT NULL ORDER BY step1.powerstatus
